name: Rocky River
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Rocky River, OH 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Rocky River, Ohio for 2026: Winter Fest with tree lighting and Santa Skate, plus the Downtown Holiday Walk parade with Santa.
seo_description: Christmas events for kids in Rocky River, Ohio for 2026: Winter Fest with tree lighting and Santa Skate, plus the Downtown Holiday Walk parade with Santa.
lede: Rocky River kicks off the season with Winter Fest at City Hall Park and the Downtown Holiday Walk with a Santa parade.
celebrates: Rocky River celebrates Christmas with two free weekend events. Winter Fest on Friday, December 4 brings a holiday market, a tree lighting with the 5th grade choir and Santa Skate, and the Downtown Holiday Walk on Saturday, December 5 brings Santa's parade, horse-drawn carriage rides, free photos with Santa and Reindeer Games.
lastyear: The Cleveland.com listing for the 2025 Rocky River Holiday Walk said it returned on December 6 starting at 11:15 am, the same morning kickoff time the city lists for 2026, so the walk is an annual tradition.
facts: The city says its events are free and family friendly. The parade begins at the Methodist Church and heads east to Old Detroit, and Santa Skate takes place at Hamilton Ice Arena.
trains: We did not find a Christmas train that runs inside Rocky River. Farther away, the Cuyahoga Valley Scenic Railroad runs a holiday North Pole Adventure on vintage trains through Cuyahoga Valley National Park between Independence and Akron, and the Lorain and West Virginia Railway runs Santa Trains with short coach and caboose rides in Wellington, according to Rally Takes the Train's Cleveland guide. Book early, since holiday trains fill up.

faq: How does Rocky River celebrate Christmas?
With Winter Fest at City Hall Park on December 4 and the Downtown Holiday Walk on December 5.
When does Santa arrive in Rocky River?
At the 11:15 am parade on Saturday, December 5.
The city says admission pricing and policies apply at Hamilton Ice Arena.
Is there a Christmas train in Rocky River?
We did not find one. Rocky River is served by RTA buses, and the Cuyahoga Valley Scenic Railroad runs a holiday train elsewhere.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Rocky River for 2026, and here is what he found: 2 family events, all of them free. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Rocky River

  • 2 Christmas events for kids in Rocky River, both free
  • Meet Santa: the Downtown Holiday Walk parade and free photos on December 5, and Santa Skate on December 4
  • Tree lighting: Winter Fest on December 4 at City Hall
  • Skating: Santa Skate at Hamilton Ice Arena (admission applies)
  • Season: December 4 to December 5
